query: Documentation and examples for implementing a custom 2D max pooling operator with AscendC (AICore) on Ascend 910B, including tiling data structures, gert::TilingContext usage, op_def registration, and PyTorch NPU custom operator integration (EXEC_NPU_CMD/aclnn).

AscendC custom operator sample for 2D MaxPool: op registration with attributes (kernel_size, stride, padding), host tiling design, and AscendC kernel implementation using local buffers and reduce max over sliding windows
Ascend C 2D max pooling custom kernel implementation with host tiling and PyTorch NPU op integration example
